title: Every type has an opposite: tag yours
caption:
Flip all four letters of your type and you get your opposite: the person who drives you up the wall, and probably teaches you the most.

The Strategist (INTJ) and The Life of the Party (ESFP). The Organizer (ESTJ) and The Poet (INFP). The Quick Wit (ENTP) and The Protector (ISFJ). The Mentor (ENFJ) and The Craftsman (ISTP).

Tag your opposite. You know who it is.
